name: hippo
description: hippo — your project's hippocampus: task registry, outcome ledger, and background clerks that give agents perception and memory — evidence over enforcement.

interface.shortDescription: Perception and memory for coding agents
interface.longDescription: hippo records what you delegated, what was accepted or refuted, and which user directives are still alive — then hands that evidence back at session start. It records; it does not enforce.
defaultPrompt: What is still open, and which directives are live?
